name: relay
description: Register the current session and exchange addressed messages with Codex, Claude, and Antigravity App sessions through a local shared channel.

interface.longDescription: Join a local Relay channel from this exact chat, list registered recipients, send messages and reply with a durable shared history. Supports Codex desktop and Claude desktop Code sessions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $relay to register this session and show the available recipients.
